fixes.explanation: Close, baker, but this one is False. Abram turns the offer down. The king of Sodom says, "Give me the people, but take the goods for yourself." Abram answers that he has raised his hand to the LORD God Most High, and he won't take even a thread or a strap of a sandal (Gen 14:21-23). He's walking away from a whole pile of goods. I think that takes a steady heart. I can't even walk past a free sample without a little taste.

False is right, baker! The king of Sodom offers Abram the goods, but Abram says no. He tells the king he has raised his hand to the LORD God Most High, and he won't accept even a thread or a strap of a sandal. He doesn't want the king saying, 'I have made Abram rich' (Gen 14:21-23). So he refuses the whole pile, down to a shoelace-sized scrap. I once got nervous turning down a cracked cookie, and this man turned down a king.
